# customer0

> Index of customer0 spikes. Each spike has its own site, source, llms.txt and eval verdict.

## Spikes

- [tether](https://tether.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Check what an agent says it did against the output it did it with. Verdict: disproven.
- [port](https://port.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Install agent infra on your own Cloudflare account. Preview it, keep it, or tear it down. Verdict: building.
- [marionette](https://marionette.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Hard ideas you can poke: autoscaling, PID, interlocks, sync. Each page is a tiny neural network wired by hand, with no ifs. Verdict: building.
- [amber](https://amber.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Pause code your agent wrote. A script stops at tool() until a human answers, then resumes mid-loop with no replay. Verdict: building.
- [accrete](https://accrete.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Build each npm CLI your agent calls once in a container, check it against the real tool, then run the saved copy in an isolate with no container boot. Verdict: building.
- [do](https://do.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Computer use without pixel guessing. The device lists what can be clicked, Clef picks one with a probability, a writer is called only for new text. Verdict: building.
- [teeth](https://teeth.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Plants small bugs in changed TypeScript files, runs the real tests against each, and reports the share the tests catch. Verdict: disproven.
